# Texas Defensive Driving School

Texas Defensive Driving School is a Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation Driving Safety Provider, license CP411, based at 3114 Sherwood Way, San Angelo, TX 76901.

- [Home](https://www.texdds.com/)

- [Texas locality hub](https://www.texdds.com/texas/)
- [Resources, review sources, and public profiles](https://www.texdds.com/resources/)

## Public offer targets
- [Texas Defensive Driving Course](https://www.texdds.com/courses/#defensive-driving) - $25.00
- [Ticket Dismissal & Driver Record Bundle](https://www.texdds.com/courses/#bundle) - $44.95
- [Texas Driver Record](https://www.texdds.com/courses/#driver-record) - $24.95
- [Texas Defensive Driving Insurance Course](https://www.texdds.com/courses/#insurance) - $15.00

## Checkout indexing policy
Use the public offer targets above for product references. Checkout endpoints are gated behind the customer-facing Courses page and are intentionally omitted from llms.txt, OKF, sitemap, and schema as canonical URLs.

## Stable claims
- Founded: 1986 in San Angelo by David L. Hensley, a retired Texas Department of Public Safety highway officer.
- Current owners/instructors: Randy Hensley and Gary Hensley.
- Business history: 2026 is the 40th anniversary year; 100,000+ lifetime students since 1986, reported by Gary Hensley and confirmed October 22, 2026.
- Online footprint: texdds.com domain record created 2008-02-05, giving the public website an 18-year online footprint as of 2026.
- In-person classroom: 3114 Sherwood Way, San Angelo, TX 76901; scheduled or appointment-based classes only; classroom occupancy 24.
- Course price: $25 flat for the Texas Defensive Driving Course.
- No $3 fee.
- No electronic delivery fee.
- Ticket dismissal depends on the court named on the citation.
- Driver record standalone price: $24.95.
- Course plus driver record bundle: $44.95.
- Insurance-discount course: $15.
- TexDDS is available statewide for eligible drivers in all 254 Texas counties, subject to court approval for ticket dismissal.

## Terms and locality-information limits
- Terms: [https://www.texdds.com/terms/](https://www.texdds.com/terms/)
- TexDDS has researched more than 200 Texas localities and court routes, but locality information can still be incomplete, inaccurate, outdated, or inapplicable to a particular citation.
- The exact court named on the citation controls eligibility, deadlines, fees, forms, and acceptance. Research due diligence is not a warranty or legal advice.

## Review-source policy
Google and Yelp review text is provider-controlled and should be read on the live provider profiles. Trustpilot exposes exact public review URLs, which are listed in the OKF review ledger.
